book.name: 1 Tesalonika
book.title: PAS NAMBA WAN PAULO MENI TESALONIKA EMA DUBURE GAENUA

content: Tua be nuso apunu-kaka gege kei awamunoya.
Be nazi o tani ne kei awai amire ge awa me wamunoi? Awa sanakare gawise sai awa oko itia.
Nikare nitopekare ego giro baititinowewa awa. Bewana wai ema meni pire kei awinowera, da ago ine be nuso mamunoya.

Are ema meni, “Bega bamu itia, are kokopai itenakai,” asinoise nuara sisaira nena ami nusokare nana eya kei awamunoya. Awa bama wasou wai meni mai pumamu inoise yaya tapinowera, da ago ine eramara nana kei awamunoya. Nena ago ine nusokare nana eya kei awai nogo nogo wero dainamunori? Dainai ine oko itia.
Ata ninekare meni awa mumera oko nowewa, are Tuara be meni bewana wai ema ine wero eya kei awai di oko tainamunowa.
Nikare zasimaira o waikora dubu wero nowewa. Nakai pira o mumera dubu oko aewa. Nakai zasimaira dubu awa.
Be kaka gamu inowenakai, are duba seka noise uma wanekai.
Are nakai erama eni meni gitawa inowera ago ine gitawa oko wanekai. Nakai uma inoise sienitinoise nuanekai.
Nakai gosinonakai. Gitawa wai nukare pire gitawa inowera, ota ou niro dau wai nukare awa pire ou niro dau inowera.

Zasimaira dubu nakai sienitinoise nuanekai. Ago inoise tuma diaire dubara dumire meni beri nasokai waise. Ota Anutu meni nakai wayara ena soyaise tuma didinowenakai ami gitira kana zewai nasokai waise.
Anutu nu be dumu nusora me pumanisekai kota, Tua nasokai Yesu Kristo meni nakai soyaise towia awa.
Nune ami nakai emo betenua. Awa nu mamunoya be amire nakai beterota seka noise numore dai eroma nuanisekai ago wenua awa.
Are nikare nitopekare kora wai ge ina-sa wero duba ina-zia wawewa zewai inowera, da ago ine inoise noiwo.
Giti kopi sou inoise ema eni dai sou wai.
Otao mamai, nikare ego wawise tonakare. Nisokare nana bua inoise tama doinowera, ota Tua emo wero nikare gita inowera, ota sero gipero awinowera, nukare awa sou wewo.
Ago inoise bua nusokare emo wero nukare emo dubara dumi pumuwo. Ago wero numorekare giwo witai wae. Ago wero bega ina-puma inoise noiwo.

Otao mamai, na nikare danara gaero sana niniu. Ema tebe-tabe nowera nukare awa ge potiwo. Ema kotumu-katumure ago awa kora wewo. Ema tuma diai beyatare awa soremuwo. Ago wero ema dapikarago amire dai duba-ozaire noiwo.
Wayara ina-wai ina-wai azu amira dia weu. Nitopekareta ema enire dai kora ina-wa inoise noiwo.
Kora waira ge.
Duba yawa sarare noiwo.
Isa zo oko duawe.
Nena neni neni amira kokopai asero Anutu bowi wewo. Kristo Yesu meni ago wawise Anutura bera towia awa.
Ozanara niao oko dawa sikimae.
Anutura bera ge porofete meni sago wero kerenitinowera awa oko azu sero isimawe.
Ata ge bamubamu ninitinowewa awa siana-katana wero ewanana wai giro puro noiwo.
Ota waya-kawaya awa dowo.
Gawa ge.

Anutu nu duba-ozaira mama nutope nikare zere dago sewero baitaise. Ititi nisokare ata duba nisokare ata tama nisokare awa zere dago pasina amu itara Tua nasokai Yesu Kristora kei awai bera ena saramai dopawise isa tona.
Nikare zawa towia ami nikare oko duamunoya. Nu bua dago wero pesunamunoya.
Ge kaka awa. Otao mamai, nikare nakare emo isa sewo.
Otao mamai, nikare na emo Yesura gegenai ema bama amira wana ina-zia wewo.
Na Tuara nana benaura sana zewai wae: Nikare pas ei awa ge ninai ema dapikarago amira benaura ena azimuwo gare.
Tua nasokai Yesu Kristora dumi yagaba meni nisokare nana itaise.
